name: keystone-engine
description: Keystone assembler engine compiled to WebAssembly
author: Amaan Qureshi <git@amaanq.com>

scripts.build: emcmake cmake -S ../.. -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release "-DKEYSTONE_ARCH=aarch64;arm;avr;bpf;csky;evm;hexagon;lanai;loongarch;m68k;mips;msp430;ppc;riscv;sparc;systemz;ve;wasm;x86;xtensa" && cmake --build build --target keystone && cmake -E copy build/keystone.mjs build/keystone.wasm .
